releaseNotes:
Notes v1.8.26 (Build 198):
• Reliable Call Ringing: One clear ringtone that always plays when ringing is on, heard over music
• Incoming Call Privacy: Normal shows your partner's name and photo, Discreet keeps it disguised
• Calls answered outside the app close back to where you were
• Hugs play and vibrate only inside Cherish
• Kiss Screen: Kisses show at the same spot on both phones; the close button no longer kisses
• Styled-hair boy in every couple emoji, no bald-looking men
